hero.name: Juathan Coelho Duarte
hero.impact: Designing and developing high-scale systems — combining robust architectures and intuitive interfaces to deliver reliable, end-to-end solutions.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Computer Scientist graduated from the Federal University of Pelotas, with experience in high-impact products, leading teams and delivering end-to-end solutions.

bio.paragraph: I am Juathan Coelho Duarte, a full-stack developer with over three years of experience, graduated in Computer Science from the Federal University of Pelotas. I work from the front-end to the back-end, participating from defining the architecture to supporting solutions, always focusing on scalability, code quality, accessibility, and high performance. I have experience leading engineering teams and projects, structuring systems to support millions of interactions, building secure and scalable APIs, and delivering products that balance technical excellence with a seamless user experience.

experience1.title: Front-End Technical Lead
experience1.description: Technical leadership of a team of 7 developers, driving strategic alignment, mentorship, code reviews, and architectural decisions across the React front-end ecosystem. Platform processing 4M+ monthly chats with an 85% bot resolution rate.

experience3.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
experience3.description: Technical leadership and end-to-end solution development, participating from architecture definition to solution maintenance, ensuring robustness, scalability, and technical excellence.

experience5.title: Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer
experience5.description: Development of end-to-end solutions, integrating data science and software engineering to deliver robust, scalable, and high-performance applications.

experience2.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
experience2.description: Architecture definition and strategic technology choices, ensuring a robust, scalable and business-aligned foundation. Coordinated the administrative dashboard front-end team.

experience4.title: Front-end / Mobile Developer
experience4.description: Android application development using React Native for equine weight control. Managed a team of over 25 students, structuring processes and selection events.

experience6.title: Computer Science Intern
experience6.description: Development and deployment of informatization projects, including computing infrastructure maintenance and device and software installation and configuration. Worked on troubleshooting and fault correction, optimization of informatized processes, municipal network supervision, and technical and administrative support.

experience7.title: IT Intern
experience7.description: Creation and implementation of technological solutions, including requirements definition and improvements to informatized processes. Worked on network and server evaluation and configuration, preventive and corrective hardware and software maintenance, software installation and configuration, implementation of new devices, and technical diagnostics and system optimization.

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.subtitle: Technologies and tools I use to create robust and scalable solutions

descriptions.letralandia: Educational app for children's literacy, featuring 3 interactive games, parent area with detailed feedback, and dedicated alphabet learning section.
descriptions.suite: Administrative dashboard integrated with omnichannel customer service area, developed for call centers and customer support with modern and intuitive interface.
descriptions.meupassApp: Mobile-first app for selling products and services, with special focus on promotional offers and optimized shopping experience.
descriptions.meupassDash: Complete administrative dashboard for managing stores in the Meupass app, including inventory control, sales, and analytics.
descriptions.clineqapp: Mobile application developed in React Native for monitoring and controlling equine weights, enabling detailed tracking of animal development and health with specific features for managing stud farms and rural properties.
descriptions.siiepe: Mobile application developed in React Native for attendance registration and control at SIIEPE academic events (Integrated Week of Innovation, Teaching, Research and Extension), facilitating participant management and certificate validation with GraphQL integration.
descriptions.blablacampus: Mobile ridesharing app between UFPEL campuses, inspired by BlaBlaCar, connecting students and staff to facilitate transportation between different university units.
descriptions.amigoDePelo: Platform for an NGO where it is possible to adopt new animals, see rescues, donations and a volunteer area with CRUD for all information, adoptions and more.
descriptions.logvcinteligencia: Intelligent platform focused on freight price optimization and market analysis, enabling strategic visualization of operational gaps and logistical efficiency opportunities based on mesoregion distribution.

experience.title: Volunteer Full-Stack Developer
experience.description: Full development of the Amigo de Pelo NGO platform, including an adoption system, rescue management, donation control, and a volunteer administrative dashboard. Utilizing modern technologies to create a scalable solution with high social impact.

experience_gc.title: Software Developer / Contributor
experience_gc.description: Developed features and optimizations for Gamers Club Booster, an open-source browser extension designed to enhance the Gamers Club platform user experience.
